title: Trap or Treasure Ep 16
kicker: Trap or Treasure  |  Trap 16 of 24  |  Director's cut
heading: Pay in 4 Is Not Free
sub: A 29 second vertical short. Rex stacks three Pay in 4 plans on Black Friday; Mei shows what is due when, and the way out.
aria: Vertical animated short: Rex splits three purchases with Pay in 4, a calendar shows 100 dollars due every two weeks, a missed payment brings fees, and one plan at a time halves each payment.
body:
The rendered video

Rex (voice: Umbriel) and Mei (voice: Leda), Google Gemini text-to-speech. 720p copy; the 1080x1920 master stays on your computer. The live preview above is the same video drawn in your browser.
